compiled_by: a1x (Sonnet 5.5): five Haiku 5.5 research shards over Wikipedia uniform histories, rules and spot checks by the lead
source_quality: Design eras and 'since' years come from Wikipedia's uniform-history pages and the 2026 uniform data (reports/u3_uniforms_2026) as read by Haiku 5.5 researchers; some URLs were seen only as search snippets. The lead re-read the Giants, Saints and Seahawks pages (see lead_check). Worn colours are text reports, not photos.

rule.text: Per team-season: R0 a sourced per-side override (the `overrides` block, from what the team wore in the game); R1 style 0 (the 2026 kit) when the season is on or after design_2026_since; R2 a retail period set when a retail era row contains the season; R3 the retail 2004 kit ('retail_current') when the season is inside the 2004 look's years for that kit (home or road), whatever the Reebok or Nike template (a5, Noah 10/8); R4 otherwise style 0 (modern by default).
rule.retail_kit_template_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Logos_and_uniforms_of_the_Seattle_Seahawks (Nike replaced Reebok as the league supplier for the 2012 season)
